# Qobra

> Qobra is a commission management and sales compensation platform that helps businesses automate variable pay, improve RevOps processes, and drive sales performance.

The site provides comprehensive resources on incentive compensation management (ICM), sales operations, and revenue operations. Content includes guides on commission tools, salary benchmarks, compensation planning strategies, and best practices for managing sales teams across multiple markets (US, UK, France).

## Key Topics

- Sales Compensation
- Commission Management
- Revenue Operations (RevOps)
- Incentive Compensation Management (ICM)
- Variable Remuneration
- Sales Performance
- Sales Operations
- Compensation Planning
- Commission Tools & Software
- Sales Team Management
- SDR & Sales Roles
- B2B Sales Strategies
- Performance Management
- Sales Accelerators
- Compensation Analysis

## Compensation & Commission Management

- [RevOps Compensation Planning: 2026 Strategies](https://www.qobra.co/blog/compensation-planning-revops): 2026 RevOps compensation planning strategies with AI tools and benchmarks
- [Designing incentive compensation plan: Key insights and best practices](https://www.qobra.co/blog/designing-incentive-compensation-plan): 5 key steps and best practices for designing incentive compensation plans
- [Sales performance: 6 benefits of a commission tool](https://www.qobra.co/uk/blog/sales-performance-benefits-commission-tool): UK blog on 6 benefits of commission tools vs Excel for sales performance
- [Performance commerciale : 6 avantages d'un outil de commissionnement](https://www.qobra.co/fr/blog/performance-commerciale-avantages-outil-commissionnement): French blog on 6 benefits of commission tools over Excel/Google Sheets
- [Components of Compensation: Key Elements](https://www.qobra.co/uk/blog/components-of-compensation): UK guide to compensation components: salary, bonuses, benefits, incentives
- [Analyse de la rémunération 2026 : guide pour les décisions salariales](https://www.qobra.co/fr/blog/analyse-remuneration): French 2026 compensation analysis guide for data-driven salary decisions
- [Commissions glossary | Qobra](https://www.qobra.co/uk/glossary): UK glossary of commission and sales compensation terminology
